title: Investment Portfolio Concentration
scenario: For each investor, find assets that account for more than 20% of their total portfolio value.
tableSchema: assets (inv_id INT, asset_id INT, value NUMERIC)
correctQuery: SELECT inv_id, asset_id FROM (SELECT inv_id, asset_id, value::NUMERIC / SUM(value) OVER(PARTITION BY inv_id) as pct FROM assets) t WHERE pct > 0.20;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE assets (inv_id INT, asset_id INT, value NUMERIC);
